# PaginationDecision

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

What a pagination primitive decides to do with its child before rendering it on the current page.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Render`: Render the child here, on this page.
- `Wrap`: Nothing can be rendered on this page; move to a fresh one and ask again. The pipeline turns this into `WrapRequired`.
- `Skip`: The child does not appear on this page at all; report completion.
